# Google Maps Scraper skill

Source: <https://github.com/gosom/google-maps-scraper>

Pinned upstream commit: `903b96d7aa8863188022c04db220e44f3218c860`
Upstream skill version: `1.12.1`

This vendored copy keeps the local Docker execution and result-status helpers.
It removes the automatic skill updater, proxy sponsor/referral flow, proxy setup,
and comprehensive-coverage guidance. Its instructions are limited to small,
targeted niche-and-location searches with human review before outreach.

The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
